title: Rav Zutra bar Tuvia
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Bava Batra 151a relates that his mother, who wished to marry Rav Zevid, wrote her property over to her son; [Rav Zevid] married her and divorced her. She came before Rav Bivi bar Abaye, who said, “[She did it] because of the marriage — and she has married.” Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua said to him: “Because you come from Mulai,” etc. Hyman concludes that this Rav Zutra bar Tuvia cannot be Rav’s student.

notes.text: The subject of “married her and divorced her” is Rav Zevid. The reviewer’s categorical rejection of a place-name for ממולאי is not adopted: saved Vilna digital Rashbam on Bava Batra 151a explicitly calls it the family’s place, while explaining Abaye’s descent from the house of Eli. Its following gloss explains the defective statements as מילי מולייתא. The reviewer’s attribution to Rashi and its purely “truncated stock” replacement are not established by this witness. Hyman’s chronological conclusion remains attributed.
